arguments.content: Default changes can turn an existing opt-in edge-case defect into a regression for ordinary callers. In batch reporting, enabling detailed output by default newly routes report([]) into mean calculation and raises ZeroDivisionError; the previous checked-in default returned Items: 0. Review default flips across valid boundary inputs and explicit overrides, comparing the pre-change and post-change default paths. Tests that cover empty input only with an explicit old-mode override can remain green while the default regresses. Preserve the enabled feature by guarding mean calculation for nonempty batches and testing both omitted mode and explicit detailed=True. Do not infer historical deployment settings from the checked-in default. Severity in this case: P1.
